layout.subappDesc: This case's Vue implementation (official Element Plus usage) has been moved to a standalone project, fused at runtime by qiankun.
layout.openLoaded: Open this case in the Vue sub-app
layout.openLoad: Load the Vue sub-app and open this case
layout.targetPost: . After loading, the sub-app’s function menu appears in the left sidebar, letting you switch between cases directly.

parentChild.title: Parent–Child Communication
parentChild.subtitle: Parent→child: props (React) vs defineProps (Vue); child→parent: callback vs custom emit event.
parentChild.emptyText: No todos yet — the child notifies the parent via the onAdd callback

propsModify.title: Modifying props
propsModify.antd: Immutable directly; ask the parent to change state via a callback
propsModify.vue: Immutable directly; v-model:xxx is syntactic sugar for emit('update:xxx')

twoWay.title: Two-way binding
twoWay.subtitle: React: controlled components (value + onChange) bind explicitly; Vue: v-model sugar (:modelValue + @update:modelValue).
twoWay.controlledNote: (the child holds no state of its own — fully controlled)

essence.title: Essence
essence.antd: one-way data flow; driven by manual onChange
essence.vue: one-way data flow (props read-only + emit); v-model is sugar

provide.title: Cross-layer passing (Provide / Inject)
provide.subtitle: Avoid prop drilling through layers: React uses createContext + Provider + useContext; Vue uses provide / inject + readonly to prevent tampering.

injectPoint.title: Declare the "injection point"
injectPoint.vue: setup() top level: provide('key', value), or app.provide() at root

default.title: Default-value mechanism
default.antd: createContext(default); returns default when not wrapped by a Provider
default.vue: inject(key, default) — the second argument is the default

reactive.title: Reactivity
reactive.antd: Provider value reference changes (setState) → all consumers re-render
reactive.vue: pass ref/reactive to provide → inject reacts automatically

safe.title: Mutation safety
safe.antd: a Context value can be any structure; agree to change it only via callbacks
safe.vue: provide(key, readonly(state)) forbids children from mutating directly

ref.title: Ref / DOM operations
ref.subtitle: React: useRef (DOM/variable) + forwardRef + useImperativeHandle (imperative API); Vue: ref="x" + defineExpose to expose methods.
ref.logEmpty: Log area below: click the buttons on the right to auto-scroll to the bottom (scrollBox.current.scrollTo)
ref.domRefCard: ① DOM Ref: operate native input / div
ref.imperativeCard: ② forwardRef + useImperativeHandle: imperative component API
ref.imperativeNote1: The parent cannot read the child’s internal state directly; it must go through
ref.imperativeNote2: explicitly exposing methods. Corresponds one-to-one with Vue 3’s

domRef.title: DOM ref declaration
domRef.vue: const r = ref(null); <input ref="r" /> (same name binds it)

crossRef.title: Passing ref across components
crossRef.vue: a child’s ref defaults to the root DOM; or $refs (options API)

readWrite.title: Reading / writing ref values
readWrite.antd: read/write r.current; changing .current does not trigger a render
readWrite.vue: read/write r.value; ref(reactive) is automatically reactive

multiRef.title: Multiple refs: lists
multiRef.antd: ref={el => arr[i] = el} (callback ref) or useRef([])

sideEffect.title: "Side-effect" DOM operations
sideEffect.antd: operate inside useEffect (after mount / after deps change)

slot.title: Slots / Children distribution
slot.subtitle: React: children / multiple ReactNode props (named) / renderItem render-prop (scoped); Vue: default slot / named slot / scoped slot with data exposure.
slot.todayText: Today is a great day. The child renders this whole block directly via props.children.
slot.namedSlot: ② Named slots: multiple ReactNode props (title / extra / footer / children)

named.title: Named slots
named.antd: multiple props: title / header / footer are all ReactNode

scoped.title: Scoped slot (list rendering)
scoped.antd: renderItem={(row, idx) => <Item />} or the itemRender prop

fallback.title: Fallback content
fallback.antd: in the container: children || default node

multiSlot.title: Multiple slots + data
multiSlot.antd: each slot prop takes (scope) => ReactNode (function slots)

scenario.title: Use cases
scenario.antd: generic Card / Modal / Table column / List itemRender
scenario.vue: same as left + the v-slot directive family

state.title: Global state sharing
state.subtitle: React: createContext + useReducer or useMemo to wrap a store; Vue: reactive + provide/inject or Pinia. This page compares "framework-native" approaches only, without Redux/Zustand/Pinia.

native.title: Approach (native)
native.antd: createContext + Provider + useContext; keep state inside the Provider
native.vue: reactive or ref object + provide(key, store); or Pinia (official store)

reference.title: State reference
reference.antd: the Provider value is a new object on every setState; reference changes re-render all consumers
reference.vue: a reactive object’s reference never changes; mutating a property precisely triggers only its subscribers

perf.title: Performance optimization
perf.antd: split into multiple Contexts / memo + useCallback / useMemo / selector libraries
perf.vue: computed derived state caches automatically; component granularity is precise

async.title: Async updates
async.vue: an action is just a plain async function that mutates reactive properties

devtools.title: Devtools
devtools.antd: React DevTools Components for Context; Redux/Zustand have dedicated panels
devtools.vue: Vue DevTools → Pinia panel or the Setup state tree
